claims.summary: Eight new source-bound courses provide two additional exact groups in each of four research domains, with 24 compact prompts per arm and 16 hash-bound projects that fail closed on source, input, prompt, model, response, compile, or recovery mismatch.
The exact retained projects report 62 of 96 raw atoms admitted for base-only Gemma versus 91 of 96 for GPT-5.4-mini, leaving local burden 29 atoms and 30.2084 percentage points higher on this task.

The compiler admits valid multiple-choice and key-term siblings independently and allows one bounded zero-atom recovery, reaching 63 of 96 local atoms while retaining every rejected sibling and burden seat.

The 372-candidate ledger yields 160 blind cases across twelve course groups and includes neutral source context on 63 selected cases, while eight atom-only pairs are excluded from full-course metrics.

Course-depth coverage is ready for research review, but zero completed reviews, zero approved training pairs, no trained quality adapter, and no held-out adapter win exist; public Scion remains base-only.
